description: Weekly Swiftember member shout-outs and special event highlights

week_1.name: Jack Dean
week_1.message: Training hard and putting in big miles in preparation for the Chicago Marathon!

week_1.name: Alice Wilkinson & Jake Colbourn
week_1.message: Massive good luck to Alice & Jake who are taking on their epic 50-mile Ultra Marathon on September 12th!

week_1.name: Neesa
week_1.message: Putting in the hard yards with strength and conditioning sessions at the gym to boost power and support her running!

week_1.name: Chris W
week_1.message: Keeping the running streak blazing strong while adding extra mileage and longer runs to the calendar!

week_2.name: Adrián Nieves
week_2.message: Currently in an injury recovery phase, Adrián is steadily rebuilding fitness with a focus on completing an 8 km run in Seville at the end of September. The club extends its best wishes for his continued recovery and upcoming event.

week_2.name: Barry Cassidy
week_2.message: Barry is managing his return from injury with structured training in preparation for the Great Scottish Run on October 4th. His disciplined approach to rehabilitation and mileage provides a solid foundation for the half marathon in Glasgow.

week_2.name: Jon Williams
week_2.message: Jon has demonstrated solid progress while recovering from injury, logging 20.0 km in Week 2 to reach 25.0 km total (71.4% of his 35 km monthly target). His consistent and measured approach also earned him the Week 2 Rising Swift award.

week_2.name: Ian Bush
week_2.message: Ian continues his steady recovery from an ankle injury, pacing his return carefully. He has logged 30.9 km to date, completing 61.8% of his 50 km monthly pledge.

week_2.name: Simon Stockdale
week_2.message: Simon is building mileage toward the Yorkshire Marathon on October 18th while working toward his 80 km Swiftember pledge. With 57.8 km completed across the first two weeks, his endurance training remains well underway.

week_2.name: Jack Whitfield
week_2.message: Jack joined the challenge this week and has already reached his monthly pledge, completing 26.3 km against his 25 km target (105.2%). A commendable effort in his opening fortnight.

week_2.name: Alice Wilkinson
week_2.message: Congratulations to Alice on completing her 50-mile Ultra Marathon on September 12th. She logged an impressive 83.0 km during Week 2, achieving 265.6% of her weekly quota and earning Road Warrior honors.

week_2.name: Jake Colbourn
week_2.message: Congratulations to Jake on finishing his 50-mile Ultra Marathon on September 12th. His week included an 81.9 km long run, 109.0 km total distance, and 1,731 m of elevation gain, earning Mountain Goat honors.

week_3.title: 🇩🇪 SPECIAL EVENT SPOTLIGHT • BMW BERLIN MARATHON 2026
week_3.headline: ALL THE BEST TO OUR 13 BERLIN MARATHON SWIFTS! 🏃‍♂️💨🇩🇪
week_3.intro: A huge club shoutout and best wishes to all 13 Birmingham Swifts heading to Germany this weekend to conquer the iconic 42.195 km Berlin course! From marathon debutants to World Marathon Major star chasers and Boston qualifiers, the entire club is cheering you across the finish line through the Brandenburg Gate!
week_3.footer: 🇩🇪 Gute Reise & smash those 42.195 km through the streets of Berlin! The whole club will be live tracking and cheering you on! 🏅

runners.name: Mark Blakeman
runners.message: Chasing his 3rd World Marathon Major star and working hard to secure a Good for Age qualifying time for the Boston Marathon.

runners.name: Alexander Brown
runners.message: Overcame tough difficulties during marathon training and picked himself right back up for the final push into Berlin.

runners.name: Bo Wang
runners.message: After Paris and London Marathon earlier this year, another dedicated marathoner on the hunt for his 3rd World Marathon Major star through the streets of Berlin.

runners.name: Chris Bainbridge
runners.message: Battled through a painful injury during training, bounced back impressively, and logged the most distance in Swiftember among all Berlin runners.

runners.name: Helen Williams
runners.message: Taking on her second full marathon of the year following the Paris Marathon earlier this spring. What a phenomenal achievement!

runners.name: Ian Allen
runners.message: A true half and full marathon junkie who trains relentlessly and has lined up for the most races among all our Berlin runners.

runners.name: Joe Pinder
runners.message: Calm, composed, and steady, quietly banking huge miles and putting tremendous effort into his Berlin Marathon build.

runners.name: Richard Lakin
runners.message: Temporarily traded his love for beer for marathon miles! Berlin is his second World Marathon Major after New York last autumn.

runners.name: Michael Lakin
runners.message: Berlin is also his second full marathon after New York last year, proving time and again that he never gives up when the going gets tough.

runners.name: Josh Savage
runners.message: Our club chair who likes to moan and complain a lot in the group chat, but backed it up with massive dedication and effort in his marathon training!

runners.name: Matthew Rushton
runners.message: A newcomer to the Berlin Marathon who caught up nicely during training and built wonderful momentum heading into race weekend.

runners.name: Tim Reeves
runners.message: Tackling his very first full marathon! Put so much hard work into this marathon training block and will definitely smash Berlin.

runners.name: Richard Wilkes
runners.message: Proud pastry and meat lover, and grueling marathon training miles haven't changed that dietary fuel strategy one single bit!

additional_shoutouts.name: London Pride 10K Swifts Team
additional_shoutouts.message: A massive club shoutout and huge congratulations to all 24 Swifts who showed up in force and took on the London Pride 10K over the weekend with fantastic club spirit and brilliant running!

additional_shoutouts.name: Benjamin Lane
additional_shoutouts.message: Came first among the Swifts team at the London Pride 10K, and clocked a blistering week to secure the Week 3 Speed Demon title!

additional_shoutouts.name: Lee Singleton
additional_shoutouts.message: The London Pride 10K is the most he has pushed himself since recovering from his injury following a seizure last year, marking an inspiring milestone!

additional_shoutouts.name: Pete Hall
additional_shoutouts.message: The London Pride 10K was his first ever official race, and he smashed it! He has also committed to a huge mileage target this Swiftember.

final_finishers.name: Adrián Nieves
final_finishers.analysis: Rebuilding fitness after injury with immense discipline, peaking in Week 4 with 17.7 km and a strong 10.0 km in Week 5.
final_finishers.shoutout: What an extraordinary comeback! You didn't just meet your 25 km target—you demolished it by over 206%, logging 51.7 km across 9 runs. From injury rehab to peak fitness for the Seville 8 km, your patience and dedication have been a masterclass in resilience!

final_finishers.name: Jon Williams
final_finishers.analysis: Quadrupled mileage from Week 1 (5.0 km) to Week 2 (20.0 km) and kept crushing 16-22 km each week.
final_finishers.shoutout: A phenomenal month of smart, progressive running! Bouncing back from injury, you quadrupled your mileage after Week 1 and never looked back, stacking 68.2 km on your 35 km goal. Consistent, measured, and unstoppable!

final_finishers.name: Anthony Morgan
final_finishers.analysis: Blazed out of the gate with 43.5 km and 38.3 km in weeks 1-2, logging a half marathon long run.
final_finishers.shoutout: Blistering pace and relentless climbing! You opened Swiftember with two massive 40 km weeks and conquered nearly 1,000 m of elevation, delivering 135.8 km on a 75 km target (+60.8 km surplus). Pure endurance brilliance!

final_finishers.name: Andrea Bohn
final_finishers.analysis: Clocked in nearly every other day with 21 separate runs, maintaining unwavering regularity across all 5 weeks.
final_finishers.shoutout: The absolute benchmark of running consistency! Lacing up 21 times across 5 weeks, you quietly transformed steady outings into 63.1 km—crushing your 35 km pledge by 180%. The habit of showing up every single week is inspirational!

final_finishers.name: David Purnell
final_finishers.analysis: Consistent 16-20 km weekly base followed by a brilliant 28.8 km surge in Week 4.
final_finishers.shoutout: Superb pacing across the month! After laying down rock-solid weekly mileage in the first three weeks, you hit hyperdrive in Week 4 with nearly 29 km, crossing the line at 89.6 km (179% of goal). Incredible engine and focus!

final_finishers.name: Harvey Degan
final_finishers.analysis: Stormed the challenge with a jaw-dropping 49.3 km in Week 1, including a 23.0 km long run.
final_finishers.shoutout: Talk about making a statement! You effectively locked down your entire monthly pledge in Week 1 alone with a staggering 49.3 km week and a 23 km long run. Finishing on 85.5 km with 474 m elevation is top-tier determination!

final_finishers.name: Ross Newman
final_finishers.analysis: Model of metronomic consistency: 24.0 km, 21.3 km, 20.4 km, and 18.7 km across the first four weeks.
final_finishers.shoutout: Clockwork consistency at its finest! You delivered four consecutive 20 km+ weeks with remarkable composure and 629 m of hill climbing, cruising to 84.4 km on your 50 km pledge (169%). Smooth, dependable, and strong!

final_finishers.name: Jack Whitfield
final_finishers.analysis: Hit his 25 km target within the first fortnight with 14.3 km and 12.0 km, adding a 15.0 km surge in Week 4.
final_finishers.shoutout: Speedy, clinical, and effective! You reached 100% of your pledge in the first fortnight, then capped it off with a 15 km Week 4 surge to finish on 41.3 km (165%). Outstanding execution from start to finish!

final_finishers.name: Richard Lakin
final_finishers.analysis: Traded beer for marathon miles! 40.9 km (W1), 32.0 km (W2), 29.9 km (W3), peaking with a 49.3 km Berlin week.
final_finishers.shoutout: Trading your beloved pints for marathon miles paid off in golden fashion! Four massive weeks peaked with a triumphant 42.6 km through the streets of Berlin, racking up 152.1 km (+52.1 km surplus). A true marathon legend!

final_finishers.name: Sam Gower
final_finishers.analysis: Unbeatable consistency: 21.9 km, 23.7 km, 23.7 km, and 27.9 km, topping 100 km total.
final_finishers.shoutout: The epitome of discipline! Week after week, you banked 22 to 28 km like clockwork, taking on London Pride 10K, climbing 818 m, and breaking through the 100 km barrier (103.4 km). Fantastic grit and momentum!

final_finishers.name: Scott Brough
final_finishers.analysis: Alternated solid maintenance with huge breakthrough weeks (30.4 km W2, 32.6 km W4).
final_finishers.shoutout: What an energetic, spirited month! From showing up in force at London Pride 10K to launching huge 30 km+ surges in Weeks 2 and 4, you effortlessly shattered your 75 km target to reach 107.8 km. Outstanding dedication!

final_finishers.name: Mark Blakeman
final_finishers.analysis: Averaged 50+ km every week (54.0, 53.1, 42.9, 59.3), completed Berlin Marathon in 42.7 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: A breathtaking masterclass in marathon endurance! With four consecutive 50 km+ weeks, 1,166 m of climbing, and a stellar Berlin Marathon, you earned your 3rd Major star and banked 215.0 km. Chasing that Boston BQ with true champion spirit!

final_finishers.name: Thomas Glave
final_finishers.analysis: Monster weeks: 74.5 km (W1), 90.0 km (W2), 86.8 km (W4), and 30.8 km (W5). Marathon long run of 42.6 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: Hail the Distance King of Swiftember! Logging 282.1 km across 24 runs and conquering 1,343 m of climbing, you set the standard for high-mileage mastery. An awe-inspiring achievement that pushed the entire club forward!

final_finishers.name: Joe Pinder
final_finishers.analysis: Triple 50 km+ weeks (52.6, 51.5, 58.9 km) culminating in a 42.6 km Berlin Marathon.
final_finishers.shoutout: Cool, calm, and effortlessly powerful! You quietly laid down three 50 km+ weeks, conquered 1,324 m of elevation, and crossed the Berlin finish line with poise to bank 208.2 km (+58.2 km surplus). A truly majestic campaign!

final_finishers.name: Jimmy Simpson
final_finishers.analysis: Consistent 20-24 km every single week, with a strong 16.2 km Week 5 wrap-up.
final_finishers.shoutout: Rock-steady rhythm week in and week out! Logging 16 runs with unmatched dependability, you built up week after week to land at 99.8 km—133% of your 75 km goal. A fantastic testament to steady, regular training!

final_finishers.name: James Chaundy
final_finishers.analysis: Kicked off with a huge 36.4 km Week 1, backed it up with 23-28 km in W3 and W4, including a 21.3 km half marathon.
final_finishers.shoutout: A powerhouse opening week and brilliant long-distance execution! Your 21.3 km half marathon and consistent high-mileage weeks brought you to 99.8 km (133% of goal) with 759 m of climbing. Fantastic running!

final_finishers.name: Bradley M 🏳️‍🌈💪🏃‍♂️
final_finishers.analysis: Doubled down with back-to-back 10.0 km and 10.1 km weeks in the second half of September.
final_finishers.shoutout: A brilliant mid-challenge surge! You ramped up your mileage right when it mattered, putting in back-to-back 10 km weeks to smash your 20 km pledge with 26.1 km (130.5%). That rainbow power and determination shone through!

final_finishers.name: Michael Lakin
final_finishers.analysis: Two 32.1 km weeks followed by a 42.7 km Berlin Marathon effort, achieving 127.6% of goal.
final_finishers.shoutout: When the going gets tough, you simply push harder! Backing up two 32 km opening weeks with an inspiring 42.7 km finish through the Brandenburg Gate, you proved your indomitable spirit and racked up 127.6 km. Magnificent effort!

final_finishers.name: Lex Hooper
final_finishers.analysis: Huge leap from 6.7 km in W1 to 18.1 km in W2 and 18.9 km in W4.
final_finishers.shoutout: What an awesome progression! You launched massive 18 km+ weeks in Weeks 2 and 4, turning a 40 km pledge into a 50.3 km triumph. Smart pacing, great endurance, and a fantastic goal-smashing finish!

final_finishers.name: John Simpson
final_finishers.analysis: Exploded in Week 2 with 39.8 km, maintaining 26-32 km through the second half with 15 km long runs.
final_finishers.shoutout: Speed and stamina in perfect harmony! After an explosive 39.8 km Week 2, you kept the throttle pinned at a rapid 5:11 /km average pace, logging 123.0 km across 14 runs with 789 m of climbing. Pure class!

final_finishers.name: Jack Dean
final_finishers.analysis: Stacked monster weeks (68.9, 74.3, 54.4 km), 22 runs, 1,908 m elevation, and 5:09 /km avg pace.
final_finishers.shoutout: A monumental training block! Training for the Chicago Marathon, you conquered 244.0 km across 22 runs with nearly 2,000 m of climbing and a sizzling 5:09 /km pace. Chicago is going to feel your power—what a run of form!

final_finishers.name: Ian Bush
final_finishers.analysis: Overcame ankle injury with structured progression, culminating in a 24.9 km Week 4.
final_finishers.shoutout: A truly inspiring comeback story! Managing an ankle injury with immense care and patience, you steadily rebuilt confidence and peaked with a 25 km Week 4 to hit 60.7 km on your 51 km target. A triumphant return to form!

final_finishers.name: Patrick Ryan
final_finishers.analysis: Burst through the target with 21.1 km in Week 2 and balanced double-digit weeks throughout.
final_finishers.shoutout: Smooth, rhythmic, and purposeful running! You paired swift 5:34 /km pacing with 548 m of elevation gain to cruise past your 50 km goal to 58.6 km. Great form, great momentum, and a thoroughly deserved finish!

final_finishers.name: Gabriel Stirling
final_finishers.analysis: High frequency (20 runs), consistent 23-32 km weekly miles, and blazing speed.
final_finishers.shoutout: Lightning fast and ultra-consistent! Lacing up 20 times across the challenge, you held a blistering 5:09 /km pace across 117.1 km, making the Top 5 Speed leaderboard. Speed, endurance, and consistency all in one!

final_finishers.name: Alexander Brown
final_finishers.analysis: Consistent 50 km+ weeks (58.0, 57.6, 48.3, 63.6 km), 1,354 m elev, 42.6 km marathon.
final_finishers.shoutout: Overcoming tough obstacles in training, you picked yourself up and built an absolute fortress of mileage—peaking with a 63.6 km week and conquering the Berlin Marathon. 233.2 km logged with immense heart and courage!

final_finishers.name: Richard Wilkes
final_finishers.analysis: Solid 38.0, 25.9, 32.3 km buildup followed by a 47.7 km Berlin Marathon week.
final_finishers.shoutout: Proof that pastries and marathon miles make the ultimate winning combination! You powered through four demanding weeks and crossed the Berlin finish line in style, logging 143.9 km with 685 m of climbing. Pure joy and dedication!

final_finishers.name: Bo Wang
final_finishers.analysis: Blasted off with an 86.1 km opening week, 20 runs, 5:11 /km pace, and completed Berlin Marathon.
final_finishers.shoutout: From an 86 km Week 1 thunderclap to securing your 3rd World Marathon Major star in Berlin, you logged 228.3 km with incredible determination and 5:11 /km pace. A fantastic milestone on your Major journey!

final_finishers.name: Pete Hall
final_finishers.analysis: Built steadily from 16.9 km to a 25.2 km Week 4 peak, tackling his first official race.
final_finishers.shoutout: What an unforgettable month for your running journey! You completed your first official race at London Pride 10K, tackled a bold 75 km pledge, and surged past it to 85.4 km with 11 solid runs. The sky is the limit!

final_finishers.name: Helen Williams
final_finishers.analysis: Second marathon of 2026! 43.7 km (W1), 28.1 km (W2), 48.7 km (W4 Berlin Marathon).
final_finishers.shoutout: Two full marathons in a single year—what an awe-inspiring achievement! Conquering Berlin on top of Paris earlier this year, you banked 141.5 km and 874 m of climbing, easily beating your 125 km pledge. True club royalty!

final_finishers.name: Chris Bloxham
final_finishers.analysis: Banked 18.2 km in Week 2 with near-10 km efforts, comfortably hitting his 35 km goal.
final_finishers.shoutout: Target locked and loaded early! With focused outings and a strong 18.2 km Week 2, you smoothly navigated past your 35 km target to 39.3 km. Efficient, well-managed, and right on the money!

final_finishers.name: Farrell Baker
final_finishers.analysis: 15 runs, 23.6, 29.7, 22.6, 16.4, 16.7 km across all 5 weeks.
final_finishers.shoutout: The definition of rhythm! You showed up every single week with 16 to 30 km, maintaining a crisp 5:15 /km pace across 15 runs and topping 109 km. A flawless, beautifully paced Swiftember campaign!

final_finishers.name: Ian Allen 🏳️‍🌈
final_finishers.analysis: 21 runs, 61.8 km W1, 59.0 km W4, Berlin Marathon finish, 1,754 m climbing.
final_finishers.shoutout: A running powerhouse who never slows down! Lacing up for 21 runs, you racked up 217.6 km, conquered Berlin, and scaled 1,754 m of elevation—all while bringing incredible vibrancy to the club. Unmatched passion and energy!

final_finishers.name: Dean Haycock
final_finishers.tag: 📈 Master of Progression: 0 to 14.2 km Peak
final_finishers.analysis: Progressed from 5 km in W2 to 8 km in W3 and a 14.2 km peak in W4.
final_finishers.shoutout: A textbook progression curve! You stepped up your distance each week, capping it off with a 14.2 km surge in Week 4 to surpass your 25 km target. Great confidence, smart ramp-up, and a well-earned celebration!

final_finishers.name: Chris W
final_finishers.tag: 🔥 The Streak Master & 14.3 km Long Run
final_finishers.analysis: Maintained his streak while logging 17.3 km (W1), 14.3 km (W3), and 22.0 km (W4).
final_finishers.shoutout: Keeping the streak alive and blazing! You paired your daily consistency with strong weekend long runs, hitting 22 km in Week 4 to comfortably surpass your 50 km goal (53.6 km). Streak on, legend!

final_finishers.name: Sam Lewis
final_finishers.analysis: Three consecutive ~21 km weeks across W1-W3, finishing on 80.0 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: Unshakeable pacing discipline! You laid down 21.9 km, 21.2 km, and 20.6 km across the opening three weeks, hitting your 75 km target with time to spare (80.0 km). Calm, steady, and thoroughly effective!

final_finishers.name: Benjamin Lane
final_finishers.analysis: 1st Swift in London Pride 10K, Week 3 Speed Demon, 40.1 km Week 2 surge, 21.6 km long run.
final_finishers.shoutout: Pure speed! Leading the Swifts at London Pride 10K and holding an average pace of 4:58 /km across 106.5 km, you showed supreme class. A half marathon long run and a 40 km peak week made this an unforgettable campaign!

final_finishers.name: James S
final_finishers.analysis: Four consecutive ~18-20 km weeks, finishing on 79.8 km on a 75 km goal.
final_finishers.shoutout: Reliable, swift, and composed! Averaging 5:20 /km across 12 well-paced runs, you kept the weekly totals between 15 and 21 km to cross your 75 km goal with ease. A wonderfully balanced Swiftember!

final_finishers.name: Matthew Rushton
final_finishers.analysis: 58.6 km Week 1, caught up rapidly during training, conquered Berlin in 42.7 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: What an entrance onto the marathon stage! A massive 58.6 km Week 1 gave you the runway to conquer the Berlin Marathon and bag 159.2 km total. You rose to the challenge brilliantly and ran with supreme pride!

final_finishers.name: Alice Wilkinson
final_finishers.analysis: Conquered a 50-mile Ultra Marathon in Week 2, logging 83.0 km in a single run.
final_finishers.shoutout: Our Endurance Titan! Conquering an 83 km 50-mile Ultra Marathon on September 12th was one of the defining moments of Swiftember 2026. Banking 132.6 km total to beat your 125 km pledge, your mental grit and physical endurance are heroic!

final_finishers.name: Christopher Bainbridge
final_finishers.analysis: 25 runs, 75.3 km W1, 61+ km every week, 1,231 m elevation, completed Berlin Marathon.
final_finishers.shoutout: The tireless workhorse! Battling through training setbacks, you bounced back to log 264.7 km across 25 runs—the highest total among all Berlin runners. Four relentless 60-75 km weeks and a glorious marathon finish. Take a bow!

final_finishers.name: Tim Reeves
final_finishers.analysis: First full marathon! 47.1 km W1, 37.0 km W2, 47.9 km W4, 158.0 km total on 150 km target.
final_finishers.shoutout: Tackling your very first full marathon with 158 km banked and over 1,000 m of climbing! You poured enormous heart and sweat into this training block, and your 42.8 km Berlin finish is an achievement you'll cherish forever!

final_finishers.name: Barry Cassidy
final_finishers.analysis: Bounced back from injury with 29.6 km, 37.0 km, and a 26.1 km Week 5 with 21.1 km half marathon.
final_finishers.shoutout: A masterful recovery and sharpening phase! Managing your return from injury with supreme discipline, you signed off Week 5 with a blistering 21.1 km half marathon effort to hit 104.7 km at 5:12 /km pace. Ready to fly in Glasgow!

final_finishers.name: Adam Bown
final_finishers.analysis: Fastest weighted average pace in the club (4:45 /km) over 208 km with 1,727 m elevation.
final_finishers.shoutout: Swift by name, swift by nature! Clocking 208.1 km across 21 runs while averaging an astonishing 4:45 /km pace and scaling 1,727 m of hills, you claimed the official Speed Demon crown. Absolutely electric running from start to finish!

final_finishers.name: Daniel Bridge
final_finishers.analysis: Stepped up from 20 km in W1 to a 32.4 km peak in W3, finishing on 67.5 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: Great tenacity and tactical pacing! Your 32.4 km peak in Week 3 did the heavy lifting, taking you past your 65 km target with 67.5 km total and 393 m of climbing. A fantastic month of running and club spirit!

final_finishers.name: James Horne
final_finishers.analysis: Hit 8.7 km, 6.2 km, and 10.0 km across 3 targeted runs to reach 24.9 km on 24 km goal.
final_finishers.shoutout: Precision engineering! You targeted 24 km and delivered 24.9 km at a rapid 5:15 /km average pace, completing exactly what you set out to achieve with no fuss and total focus. Spot on!

final_finishers.name: Matt Mackinnon-Coleman
final_finishers.analysis: Consistent 24-30 km weeks in W2-W4, 13 runs, 5:25 /km average pace.
final_finishers.shoutout: A century of kilometers backed by serious hill power! Clocking 102.4 km across 13 runs with 874 m of elevation gain and a swift 5:25 /km pace, you made joining the Century Club look easy. Tremendous effort!

final_finishers.name: Jake Colbourn
final_finishers.analysis: Most runs in the club (27), 81.9 km Ultra, 3,074 m elevation (club record), 204.4 km total.
final_finishers.shoutout: Our undisputed Mountain Goat and run frequency champion! Logging 27 runs, conquering an 81.9 km 50-mile Ultra, and climbing a staggering 3,074 m of elevation, your endurance and resilience this month were nothing short of superhuman!

final_finishers.name: Lee Singleton
final_finishers.analysis: Overcame seizure recovery, ran London Pride 10K, balanced 22-27 km weekly to hit 102.0 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: One of the most inspiring achievements of Swiftember! Pushing through recovery from last year's seizure, you laced up 13 times, conquered London Pride 10K, and crested the 100 km mountain with 102.0 km and 863 m of elevation. True Swifts courage!

final_finishers.name: Laura Rafailov
final_finishers.analysis: Consistent four weeks of 20-30 km, finishing strong with 12.0 km in W5 to break 100 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: Century conquered in style! From joining the Pride 10K squad to steadily banking 20 to 30 km each week, you crossed the finish line at 101.8 km with 666 m of climbing. Fantastic focus and wonderful club spirit!

final_finishers.name: Neesa
final_finishers.analysis: Combined gym S&C with an incredible 38.0 km long run in Week 2 to lock in 50.9 km.
final_finishers.shoutout: Strength and power in action! Balancing heavy gym strength and conditioning work, you unleashed a monumental 38.0 km run in Week 2, locking in your 50 km target before mid-month. That strength training paid immense dividends!

final_finishers.name: Tom dawson
final_finishers.analysis: Delivered 24.1 km in W2 and 21.5 km in W3 to hit 101.3% of his 45 km pledge.
final_finishers.shoutout: Two decisive, high-impact weeks! You delivered back-to-back 20 km+ weeks in Weeks 2 and 3, effortlessly hitting 45.6 km to secure your Swiftember goal. Efficient, composed, and job done!

final_finishers.name: Phil Deeley
final_finishers.analysis: Consistent opening fortnight (25.9 km, 23.8 km) backed by 14 runs across the month.
final_finishers.shoutout: Fourteen runs of pure commitment! You laid down two strong 25 km weeks early on, maintaining focus throughout the month to reach 69.7 km on your 69 km pledge with 408 m of climbing. Superb dedication!

final_finishers.name: James Evans
final_finishers.analysis: Two focused 5 km runs in Week 4 to hit 10.1 km on 10 km pledge.
final_finishers.shoutout: Clutch performance under pressure! When Week 4 arrived, you stepped up with two crisp 5 km runs, hitting 10.1 km and sealing your 100% completion badge with precision. Fantastic execution!

final_finishers.name: Joshua Burnett
final_finishers.analysis: Unleashed a massive 53.5 km Week 2 including a 43.1 km marathon-plus distance long run.
final_finishers.shoutout: A breathtaking marathon effort! In Week 2 you unleashed an epic 43.1 km long run as part of a 53.5 km week, ultimately logging 95.9 km on your 95 km target. That long-run grit was unforgettable!

final_finishers.name: Joshua Savage
final_finishers.analysis: 18 runs, 201.4 km logged, 2,759 m elevation, conquered Berlin Marathon.
final_finishers.shoutout: Leading from the front! You might complain in the club chat, but on the roads you delivered 201.4 km, scaled an enormous 2,759 m of elevation, and conquered the Berlin Marathon with true grit. A proud achievement for our club chair!

final_finishers.name: Josh Heer
final_finishers.analysis: Executed a flawless 10.0 km run to hit exactly 100.0% of his pledge.
final_finishers.shoutout: The ultimate bullseye! You promised 10.0 km and delivered exactly 10.0 km on the dot at 6:36 /km pace. No wasted motion, no fuss—pure, perfect completion. Welcome to the Finisher Roll of Honor!
